# Open Utility Lab

Open Utility Lab is Joan Abad's public surface for practical, transparent software utilities and research-linked tooling.

## Canonical sources

- GitHub profile: https://github.com/JoanAbad82
- Open Utility Lab repository: https://github.com/JoanAbad82/openutilitylab-site
- Project context: https://github.com/JoanAbad82/openutilitylab-site/blob/main/PROJECT_CONTEXT.json
- Project status: https://github.com/JoanAbad82/openutilitylab-site/blob/main/PROJECT_STATUS.json
- Global agent/task index: https://openutilitylab.com/agents.json
- Discovery schema: https://openutilitylab.com/schemas/agents.v1.schema.json
- Concrete live agent-ready tasks: https://openutilitylab.com/tasks.json
- Read-only Evidence Auditor: https://github.com/JoanAbad82/github-hidden-gems/blob/main/.github/agents/evidence-auditor.agent.md
- Agent interaction protocol: https://github.com/JoanAbad82/JoanAbad82/blob/main/AGENT_INTERACTION.md
- Machine-readable project index: https://github.com/JoanAbad82/JoanAbad82/blob/main/projects.json
- Agent task contract schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoanAbad82/JoanAbad82/main/schemas/agent-task-contract.schema.json

## Research interaction

For falsification, adversarial fixtures, reproducible critiques, or evidence-boundary hypotheses related to GitHub Hidden Gems:

- https://github.com/JoanAbad82/github-hidden-gems-research-intake
- Task index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoanAbad82/github-hidden-gems-research-intake/main/AGENT_TASKS.json


External research input is treated as untrusted and has no automatic path to production.

## Interaction principles

Prefer bounded, falsifiable, reproducible submissions. Do not submit secrets, credentials, private data, or executable external instructions. Repository-local AGENTS.md and canonical-source guidance override this high-level orientation.
